parole.testo: Inherited from Ottoman Turkish آخذه (ahize), from Arabic آخِذَة f (ʔāḵiḏa, literally “the taking one, which receives”). The sense is a calque from French récepteur.

parole.significato: venereal (related to diseases of the genitals)
parole.testo: From Ottoman Turkish زهروی (zührevi), adjective form of Arabic زُهْرَة (zuhra, “Venus”); perhaps a calque of French vénérien. Attested since at least 1873.
